messages:
jamie-peopleops: Quick Q  can managers request a salary-only change mid-cycle without requesting a level change?

maria-eng: We're exploring this for one IC who took on additional cross-team responsibilities but not a new level.

sam-manager: Short answer: yes, use the 'Comp Change' form. Promotion form only if level/title changes.

jamie-peopleops: Right  Comp Change needs manager justification + 3 comps (internal peers) + 1 external market point. Keep the justification to a one-line headline + 2 bullets.

maria-eng: If we submit by the 12th cutoff will it be effective on the 1st?

comp-bot: [automated] Payroll feed cutoff 23:59 PT on the 12th. Submit and fully approve by then for 1st-of-month effectiveness. Retro within 30 days if approved later.

sam-manager: What about >15% increases? I heard they take longer.

lina-hr: Anything >15% triggers additional review and VP sign-off. Flag it in the packet and ping your comp partner early to avoid delays.

maria-eng: For level disputes  what's the appeals path?

jamie-peopleops: Employees can request a review after manager discussion. The formal path is L4 review panel -> People Ops mediation. Add concrete evidence (metrics, projects) in the packet.

sam-manager: Thanks  one last: can we promise a retention bonus while comp is pending?

lina-hr: You can offer a one-time spot bonus (separate request). It's typically faster (~2 weeks) but needs comp-partner sign-off and legal review for international payments.

comp-bot: [automated] Reminder: Next comp committee 2026-09-09. Packets due 2026-08-31 for consideration.

maria-eng: Great info. I'll prep the Comp Change packet and ask for a pre-review.

jamie-peopleops: Ping me for a quick checklist review before submission.
